page.layout: Running head centred at top ("INDEX"). One column of chronological entries, page numbers at the right of each line. A brace joins three entries under the label "eodem tempore". page.notes: Only the Latin of the page is transcribed. Long s is written as s throughout. The page numbers 210, 217, 224 and 227 are read from small figures and are not certain. The brace grouping AEternales, Chiliastæ and Liberatores is shown as diagram lines. The spelling "Chiliastæ" is read from a ligature and may be "Chiliasta". No page number, catchword or signature is printed. Show-through from the reverse side is excluded.
